foods.name: Apples
healthNotes: Doused with post-harvest chemicals; EWG Dirty Dozen.

foods.name: Pears
healthNotes: Thin skin retains high pesticide residues; EWG Dirty Dozen.

foods.name: Peaches & Nectarines
healthNotes: Soft, porous skin absorbs pesticides easily; EWG Dirty Dozen.

foods.name: Cherries
healthNotes: Thin skin retains heavy pesticide loads; EWG Dirty Dozen.

foods.name: Bananas
healthNotes: Thick peel blocks pesticide transfer.

foods.name: Wild Blueberries
healthNotes: 2x the antioxidant capacity of cultivated varieties.

foods.name: Cultivated Blueberries
healthNotes: Frequently test positive for toxic pesticides; EWG Dirty Dozen.

foods.name: Strawberries & Blackberries
healthNotes: Porous structure retains heavy pesticide sprays; EWG Dirty Dozen.

foods.name: Grapes
healthNotes: Thin skin easily absorbs pesticide sprays; EWG Dirty Dozen.

foods.name: Watermelon
healthNotes: Thick rind acts as a natural barrier.
appearance: Look for a creamy yellow spot.
Choose one with a dull finish.
It should feel heavy for its size.

foods.name: Cantaloupe & Honeydew
healthNotes: Thick outer rinds block pesticides; EWG Clean Fifteen.

foods.name: Avocados
healthNotes: Thick skin blocks pesticide transfer; EWG Clean Fifteen.

foods.name: Pineapple
healthNotes: Thick skin blocks pesticide transfer.
appearance: It should smell sweet at the base.

foods.name: Broccoli & Kale Sprouts (Microgreens)
healthNotes: Up to 40x the nutrient density of mature greens.

foods.name: Spinach
healthNotes: Highest pesticide residue by weight of all produce; EWG Dirty Dozen.

foods.name: Kale & Collard Greens
healthNotes: Can carry up to 20 different pesticides; EWG Dirty Dozen.

foods.name: Romaine & Leafy Lettuce
healthNotes: Large surface area catches chemical sprays.

foods.name: Potatoes
healthNotes: 90% of conventional potatoes carry post-harvest chemical sprout inhibitors; EWG Dirty Dozen.
storageNotes: Can often be stored for months.

foods.name: Sweet Potatoes
healthNotes: Directly absorb soil chemicals during growth.

foods.name: Carrots
healthNotes: Grown underground with low residue; EWG Clean Fifteen.
storageNotes: Can often be stored for months.

foods.name: Bell & Hot Peppers
healthNotes: Thin skin retains heavy pesticide loads; EWG Dirty Dozen.

foods.name: Onions
healthNotes: Sulfur compounds and underground bulbs resist pesticide buildup; EWG Clean Fifteen.
storageNotes: Can often be stored for months.

foods.name: Garlic
healthNotes: Sulfur compounds and underground bulbs resist pesticide buildup; EWG Clean Fifteen.

foods.name: Broccoli & Cauliflower
healthNotes: Minimal pesticide retention; EWG Clean Fifteen.

foods.name: Cabbage
healthNotes: Protective outer leaves limit chemical absorption; EWG Clean Fifteen.

foods.name: Eggs
healthNotes: Deep orange yolks; outdoor foraging boosts omega-3s and lutein.
avoid: Avoid “Cage-Free” and “Vegetarian-Fed”: birds remain crammed indoors on soy/corn feed.

foods.name: Beef
healthNotes: 5x the omega-3s, higher CLA, and robust antioxidants.
avoid: Avoid plain “Grass-Fed”: animals are still fattened on feedlot grain during final months.

foods.name: Poultry
healthNotes: Outdoor foraging optimizes healthy fat ratios and vitamin E.
avoid: Avoid “Free-Range” and “Natural”: often means minimal access to a small outdoor porch.

foods.name: Salmon
healthNotes: Rich in natural astaxanthin antioxidants and clean omega-3s.
avoid: Avoid “Farm-Raised” / “Atlantic”: higher PCB contaminants and synthetic color additives.

foods.name: Shrimp
healthNotes: Cleaner ocean sourcing.
avoid: Avoid imported farmed shrimp: notorious for heavy antibiotic use in farm water.

foods.name: Milk & Cream
healthNotes: Preserves vital vitamin K2 and fat-soluble vitamins.
avoid: Avoid “Skim” / “Fat-Free”: strips away essential fat-soluble vitamins A, D, E, and K.

foods.name: Butter
healthNotes: Significantly higher omega-3s and CLA content.
buyingTips: Choose butter made from grass-fed whole milk.

foods.name: Brown Rice
healthNotes: Has much higher levels of arsenic than white rice.
storageNotes: Contains more natural oils and goes rancid much sooner.
